# Getting started

## Install

To install sqlpipe, run this command:

```
curl -sSL https://get.sqlpipe.dev | sh
```

The installer puts the sqlpipe binary on your system.

## Configure

sqlpipe reads its settings from a file named `sqlpipe.yaml`. Make this file in your project directory. In the file, set your source database, your target database, and the tables that you want to move.

## First run

When the configuration file is ready, run this command:

```
sqlpipe run --config sqlpipe.yaml
```

sqlpipe reads the file and starts the data transfer. The tool shows the progress of each step on the screen. When the transfer is complete, sqlpipe shows a summary of the rows that it moved.

If an error occurs, sqlpipe stops and shows a message. Read the message, correct the configuration file, and run the command again.
